operator_attestation: This week's current work is offline grader diagnostics, read-only rechecks and evidence repair. No new product task was submitted during this work. The public package diff is a cross-check, not proof about unrecorded executions.

definitions.independent_run: One actually submitted product task/session with its own input, configuration, start/end and public evidence. New grading rows, tool calls, screenshots, synthetic answers and replayed artifact checks are not product runs.
definitions.valid: Run conditions are valid and the task outcome can be judged; includes both passing and failing product outcomes
definitions.failed: A subset of valid: a known product/task failure, never merely absent internal evidence
definitions.unknown: Run validity or task outcome cannot be established; report separately and investigate under the unknown register
definitions.invalid: Explicit infrastructure-invalid run; neither a product failure nor evidence of success
